articles.author: Celularity Inc
articles.headline: Celularity Provides Update Regarding Nasdaq Listing Compliance
articles.summary: Celularity disclosed Nasdaq noncompliance for late quarterly reports and a required compliance plan. The notice did not immediately suspend its listing.

articles.author: Celularity Inc
articles.headline: Celularity and MuseCell Innovations Announce U.S. Manufacturing Collaboration for the Dezawa MuseCell Platform
sourceWarnings: La cifra superior a 300 millones era una proyección condicionada de MuseCell, no ventas realizadas ni pedidos firmes garantizados.
articles.summary: Celularity and MuseCell announced a manufacturing collaboration. The more-than$300 million five-year purchase figure was MuseCell's projection contingent on expanded collaboration, not a firm completed order book.
